title: Claude MARKS Everything Over 150 Words
description:
Anthropic has documented that Claude will watermark its own text output — and the mark is built into the word choice, not into a character you could strip out.

• MECHANISM: at each token, a secret key biases selection toward a "green" set of words and away from a "red" set. The resulting statistical pattern is detectable by Anthropic and invisible to a reader.
• THRESHOLD: applies to output above roughly 200 tokens (~150 words), across Claude models, globally.
• ANTHROPIC'S POSITION, quoted: the watermark is "imperceptible" and "doesn't change the meaning, quality, or readability".
• THE PUSHBACK: John Gruber calls it a perversion of writing (398 points, 390 comments on Hacker News overnight). Commenters push back on him just as hard — LLMs already sample probabilistically, so a weighted roll is not a new kind of interference.
• STATED AS AN ABSENCE, NOT A CLAIM: no user-facing opt-out appears in the documentation, and nobody in that thread found one.
